challenge.desc.reaction: Pop targets fast before time runs out, across several rounds. Miss the timer and you restart.

reliability.title: Reliability
reliability.intro: What your phone has to allow for alarms to ring on time. Nothing here sends anything anywhere.
reliability.exact_alarms_note: Without this alarms can ring late, or not at all.
reliability.notifications_note: Without them there may be no way into the alarm screen.
reliability.full_screen_note: Without this the alarm cannot come up over the lock screen.
reliability.overlay_note: Without this you only get a notification while using the phone.
reliability.battery_note: Can delay or stop alarms overnight.
reliability.background_note: This app is restricted, which can stop alarms.
reliability.unused_note: On the next page, turn off the switch for unused apps.
reliability.channel_note: Turned down, so the alarm screen may not come up.
reliability.silence_note: Do Not Disturb is on total silence, which silences alarms too.
reliability.boot_signal_note: After the last restart, alarms only came back when you opened the app. Turn on auto-start for AlarmFree in your phone's settings.
reliability.test_note: Phone makers differ, so a test alarm is the only sure check: it rings for real within 2 minutes, with the app closed.
reliability.test_set: Rings within 2 minutes. Lock your phone.

help.title: Help
help.q_ring: Why did my alarm not ring?
help.a_ring: Most often the phone stopped the app. Open Reliability and fix what it lists: exact alarms, battery saver, running in the background. Some makers add a switch of their own. Xiaomi, Oppo, OnePlus, Realme, Vivo and Huawei: turn on auto-start and background activity for AlarmFree. Samsung: take AlarmFree out of Sleeping apps and set its battery use to Unrestricted. Pixel and others: set battery use to Unrestricted.
help.a_backup_challenge: Every challenge has a way out: Can't do this one? Hold instead. It is slow on purpose. If the app itself keeps failing while an alarm rings, a backup screen takes over: hold the button {holds} times to stop it.
help.q_backup: How do I back up or restore my alarms?
help.a_backup: Open Settings, then Back up or restore. Save to a file puts your alarms in the Downloads folder. On a new phone, choose Add alarms from a file. Your own sounds go in the file if you choose Save alarms with my sounds; the file is then bigger. Your photos are not in it.
help.a_data: Nothing. No ads, no accounts, no analytics. Your alarms stay on your phone. The app keeps a short log of what it does, with times and never names or notes, so a problem can be traced. It only leaves the phone when you send a report yourself.
report.title: Report a problem or idea
report.intro: Tell what went wrong, or what you would like. Nothing is sent from here: your own email app opens with the report ready, and you press send there.
report.log_note: The log lists what the app did, with times, never names or notes. The alarm setup is a file with your alarms including their names and notes, so the exact alarms can be rebuilt.
report.preview_note: This is the report that is attached as alarmfree-report.txt.

report.saved_no_address: No email app found. The report was saved to {place}. Send it to the developer (the address is on the Play Store page).
report.failed: The report could not be saved.
report.trouble: Something went wrong last time. Send a report?
intro.1_title: An alarm you cannot just snooze away
intro.1_body: AlarmFree rings on time, every day or on a date you pick, with the sound, vibration and look you choose. No ads, no accounts, no tracking.
intro.2_body: Add a challenge to an alarm: solve a sum, repeat a pattern, walk some steps, scan a code in the bathroom. Only then does it stop.
intro.3_body: Phones like to stop alarm apps to save battery. The next screen shows what to allow, and a test alarm proves it works.
lock.title: This alarm is locked
lock.help: Locked until it rings at {time}. To change it now, do its challenges.
lock.opened: Open for {minutes} minutes, then it locks again.
lock.pause_all: Cannot pause all: {alarm} is locked until it rings.
lock.skip_refused: {alarm} is locked, so it was not skipped. Open the app and do its challenges to change it.
config.edit_lock_note: Shortly before the alarm rings you cannot switch it off or change it, unless you do its challenges. After that it is open for 5 minutes. It cannot stop you from force-stopping the app, clearing its data or uninstalling it.
help.a_lock: With the edit lock on, an alarm cannot be switched off, changed, deleted, skipped or paused in the last stretch before it rings. You choose how long that is for each alarm. To change it anyway, do its challenges. An alarm without challenges asks you to hold the button {holds} times. Then it is open for {minutes} minutes. Duplicating, rearranging, backing up and Undo stay possible. The lock cannot stop you from force-stopping AlarmFree, clearing its data or uninstalling it.
